As the week progresses, your confidence returns, and you'll begin to notice doors opening in both your personal and professional life. This is an excellent time to strengthen foundations instead of chasing instant results. By the weekend, you'll feel more optimistic and ready to move forward with renewed clarity. Explore what Sandeep Agarwal of Meditate Wisdom predicts in this weekly horoscope for Aries, offering insights into balance, strategy, and resilience through this detailed Aries weekly horoscope.

Quote of the Day by Aretha Franklin: “You cannot define a person on just one thing...” – Inspiring lessons on forgiveness, character, fairness, compassion and everyone deserves a second chance by the Queen of Soul known for her powerful voice, timeless music and deep insights into dignity, respect and human nature
articles.description: Quote of the Day by Aretha Franklin: Aretha Franklin’s quote, “You cannot define a person on just one thing. You can't just forget all these wonderful and good things that a person has done because one thing didn't come off the way you thought it should come off,” explores the importance of fairness, compassion, and balanced judgment. The quote suggests that a person's character should be measured by the entirety of their actions, values, and contributions rather than by a single mistake, failure, or moment that falls short of expectations.

articles.title: 9MT Numaligarh Expansion On Track; Investing Upto ₹4000 Cr To Set Up 25 CBG Plants: OIL CMD
articles.description: Oil India’s Numaligarh Refinery in Assam is on track to triple its capacity from three to nine million tonnes by early 2027. To facilitate feedstock to the refinery, a 1600 km long pipeline has been commissioned from Paradip to Numaligarh, works of which will be completed by Oct-Nov 2026. Concurrently, Oil India is also deploying up to ₹4000 crore capex to build 25 compressed biogas plants. Imminent state pacts with Assam, Odisha, and Chhattisgarh are being signed to monetize municipal waste and hit the governments 5% blending goal by 2030, Business Today talks to Ranjit Rath, CMD, Oil India ltd.
